crudSummary.create: Register new instrument suppliers, generate stock purchase orders (POs), and record incoming stock batches with warranty batches.
crudSummary.read: Monitor live warehouse stock levels, review automated low-stock and reorder alerts, and inspect supplier performance records.
crudSummary.update: Automatically deduct available stock on checkout, adjust stock counts for returns or damages, and update supplier contract/contact details.
crudSummary.delete: Deactivate discontinued supplier profiles and cancel draft or invalid purchase order requisitions.

assignedErrors.name: Duplicate Supplier Business Registration Number
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when attempting to register a supplier with a Business Registration Number (BRN) already present in the database.
assignedErrors.message: Supplier with Business Registration Number "PV-10928/LK" is already registered in the system.

assignedErrors.name: Non-Positive Purchase Order Quantity Requisition
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when creating a purchase order requisition with a quantity less than or equal to zero.
assignedErrors.message: Purchase order quantity must be greater than zero. Received: 0

assignedErrors.name: Physical Stock Balance Deficit
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when a manual or damaged inventory adjustment causes warehouse stock to drop below zero.
assignedErrors.message: Stock adjustment rejected. Current stock is 4, deduction of 50 would result in negative stock balance (-46).

endpointsTested: GET /api/inventory/status - Real-time warehouse balance, low stock alerts, stock valuation
POST /api/inventory/adjust - Adjust stock for damages, returns, or manual audits
POST /api/inventory/purchase-order - Create PO and record incoming stock batch
GET /api/suppliers - List registered suppliers with ratings and contract statuses
POST /api/suppliers - Register new musical equipment supplier
PUT /api/suppliers/:id - Update supplier contracts and contact details
